title: psoralea mephitica var. retrorsa
intro: Psoralea mephitica var. retrorsa, commonly known as Wolf's Bane, is a plant species native to Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as infections, wounds, and skin issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, promote wound healing, and exhibit anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Wolf's Bane include coumarins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
